title: Inventory current PGIR, ContextPack, compression, proof, and source-map systems

freshness_check.method: git diff --quiet -- Mcp-Plus-Plus external/ipfs_accelerate external/ipfs_datasets external/ipfs_kit
freshness_check.meaning: No tracked submodule overlay was present when the inventory binding was measured. The binding becomes stale if any listed commit, tree, or source digest changes.

negative_assertions: No local alias is claimed as canonical identity.
No model output is claimed as proof, mutation, or validation authority.
No M2 or M3 abstraction is granted mutation authority.
No competing ContextPack, proof store, semantic compiler, or source-map authority was created.

inventory.system: PGIR semantic public API and canonical structured-text IR
inventory.finding: The existing PGIR catalog is a versioned discovery surface with canonical compile, decompile, translation, verification, and publication operations. It is reusable as semantic authority, but it is not a current-tree Python AST/CFG/data-flow compiler or M1 source linker.

inventory.authority: ipfs_datasets_py builds identity; ipfs_accelerate_py consumes it; Mcp-Plus-Plus owns wire schema only
inventory.finding: The builder deterministically derives a pack CID from schema, interface, repository state, exact source CIDs, capsule CIDs, scanned tree, and freshness inputs; stale, unavailable, and opaque-without-exact-tree cases fail closed. PCSM must consume this authority rather than fork it.

Accelerator has unavailable-aware semantic-compression metrics and paired ContextPack benchmark support. Kit's compression encoding is byte/storage compression, not semantic minification; it must not be used as a semantic-equivalence claim.

inventory.system: Proof-carrying artifact and immutable proof bytes
inventory.authority: ipfs_datasets_py validates semantic proof lineage; ipfs_kit_py verifies exact bytes and CIDv1 storage
inventory.finding: Existing proof artifacts bind mandatory semantic, contract, proof, test, static, security, policy, and authority lineage and reject forged IDs, stale roots, missing lineage, and producer flags. Kit rejects byte/CID disagreement and verifies fetched bytes.

The syntax-core source-map contract is deterministic and versioned, but it maps syntax-core documents/tokens rather than exact current Python AST node and mutable-span identity. It is a reusable contract component, not an M1 Python source-link receipt.

relevant_controls: ContextPack CID derives from exact source and scanned-tree inputs.
Kit verifies supplied bytes against CIDv1 base32 identity.
MCP++ CID behavior schema is RFC 8785 canonicalization-bound and rejects pseudo-CID new mints.

minimum_versioned_delta.reason: No existing component simultaneously provides a Python current-tree CanonicalCodeIR, exact Python AST/CFG/data-flow identity, M1 mutable-span source map, alias-to-canonical relinking, and deterministic bounded source rewrite. Inventing that delta in an inventory receipt would violate task scope and authority boundaries.
minimum_versioned_delta.non_promotion_effect: No PCSM projection, patch plan, source link, or automatic mutation is admitted by this task.

coverage: identical inputs yield identical ContextPack CID
stale, unavailable, and opaque wrong-tree inputs fail closed
round-trip and independent replay positive cases
forged CID, stale roots, missing lineage, producer flags, omitted checks, and lineage mismatch rejection
canonical CID positive vectors and equivalent-input determinism
negative vectors and NaN/infinity canonicalization rejection
valid schema instances and RFC 8785 canonicalization
unknown fields/statuses, pseudo-CIDs, wrong schema markers, and simulated provenance rejection
heuristic-critical replacement, item limit, and non-identity rejection
semantic ContextPack and reproducible token-accounting rejection paths

PCSM_specific_test_gap.statement: No current-head test was found for a PCSM-specific Python CanonicalCodeIR-to-source-link pipeline because that pipeline is not yet implemented; this receipt does not relabel adjacent-system tests as PCSM validation.

Existing positive and negative test source declarations were directly inspected.
unavailable: PCSM-specific Python semantic compiler, M1 source map/linker, and linker test suite are absent at this current head.
Existing upstream/nested test suites were inventoried but not executed by this receipt-only task.
No external prover execution is claimed or required for a read-only inventory.

assertions: receipt contains current-tree bindings, source digests, authority decisions, positive/negative test inventory, and typed unavailable evidence

All source digests bind the exact tree above; freshness must be rechecked before any follow-on reuse.
